title: AI is the new storefront, and cost pressure will shape our PC pricing
summary: 55% of shoppers use AI in discovery (NIQ); 400M used Alexa for Shopping and spend 50% more (Amazon). Asus sees Taiwan commercial PC prices up ~10% in 2H26; Samsung sees no memory relief before 2028; Apple plans 16M MacBook Neo units in 2027.

points.headline: AI assistants now steer product discovery and spend
points.detail: 55% of consumers use AI in discovery (NIQ) and Alexa shoppers spend 50% more (Amazon). Amazon also widened Shop Direct to keep discovery in-house. Our listings must be readable by AI agents.

points.headline: Memory costs keep PC prices rising with no relief before 2028
points.detail: Asus expects Taiwan commercial PC prices up nearly 10% in 2H26 after a ~30% H1 surge, and Samsung sees no buyer relief before 2028. We should plan pricing, promotions and stock for sustained cost pressure.

points.headline: Apple is pushing hard into laptops with touch and a doubled MacBook Neo plan
points.detail: Apple showed touchscreen laptops and told suppliers to plan 16M MacBook Neo units in 2027, double 2026. Expect sharper laptop competition and promotions; review our entry-level and touch lineup online.

points.headline: PC demand is soft, but consumer promotions and AI PCs still grow
points.detail: AMD plans for a weaker 2027 PC market, yet Acer Taiwan consumer shipments rose 15% and Intel AI PC sales grew. We should lean on AI PCs and Singles' Day style promotions.
